faq.q0: Can I change the fabric or color?
faq.a0: Yes, most designs can be customized by fabric, color, and size.
faq.a1: We do not display fixed prices; they are agreed via WhatsApp based on size, fabric, and details.
faq.q2: Is delivery available to the West Bank and 1948 areas?
faq.a2: Delivery is arranged with the showroom based on area and order.
faq.q3: How do I order a design?
faq.a3: Choose a design or fabric, add it to your interest list, then send the details via WhatsApp.
faq.q4: Can I send more than one design?
faq.a4: Yes, use the interest list to send multiple designs or fabrics in one message.
